title: discretize

gpu_support.notes: The current implementation gathers resident inputs and returns host output. MATLAB documents gpuArray support except for categorical replacement values, so output residency remains a compatibility gap.

description: `discretize(X,edges)` returns one-based bin numbers for values in `X` using numeric bin edges. Integer X, edges, and replacement values support all eight integer classes.
behaviors: Explicit integer X and edges are compared from authoritative typed storage, including values beyond flintmax; edges must be monotonically increasing and consecutive repeated edges are accepted.

`discretize(X,N)` creates N equal-width double edges, and `[Y,E] = discretize(X,N,___)` returns those computed edges as the second output. Explicit-edge calls return only Y. The current implementation materializes X in the floating computation domain for the scalar-bin-count form.
Only NaN values in X are intrinsically missing. Positive and negative infinity are binned normally when the corresponding outer edge is infinite.
Numeric replacement values preserve their class. Out-of-range and NaN inputs become NaN for floating replacement values and zero for integer replacement values.
String replacement values and the `IncludedEdge` name-value option are supported; the default is left-inclusive/right-exclusive with the final edge included.
Categorical replacement output is not yet implemented.
